description_en: Modifies the Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) settings of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifySagRouteProtocolOspf修改动态路由协议OSPF配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-route-protocol-ospf --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a30000 --router-id 192.XX.XX.1 --area-id 86 --dead-time 10 --hello-time 3 --authentication-type NONE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagRouteProtocolOspf

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the router that has OSPF enabled.

Set the value to an IPv4 address
parameters.help_zh:
OSPF路由器ID。

取值格式为IPv4地址格式
parameters.name: router_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the OSPF area.

Valid values: 1 to 2147483647
parameters.name: area_id

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of OSPF. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
OSPF超时时间间隔。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: dead_time

parameters.help_en:
The time interval at which Hello packets are sent. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
发送Hello报文的时间间隔。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: hello_time

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:

NONE: does not enable authentication.
CLEARTEXT: uses plaintext authentication. You must enter the plaintext password.
MD5: uses MD5 authentication. You must enter the MD5 key ID and the MD5 key
parameters.help_zh:
认证方式。取值：

NONE：不开启认证。

CLEARTEXT：采用明文认证，需输入明文密码。

MD5：采用MD5认证，需输入MD5 Key ID和MD5 Key
parameters.name: authentication_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the MD5 key.

Valid values: 1 to 2147483647.

This parameter is required only if AuthenticationType is set to MD5
parameters.help_zh:
MD5 Key的编号。

取值范围：1~2147483647。

该项仅当AuthenticationType为MD5时输入
parameters.name: md5_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The MD5 key value.

Valid values: 1 to 47.

This parameter is required only if AuthenticationType is set to MD5
parameters.help_zh:
MD5 Key值。

取值范围：1~47。

该项仅当AuthenticationType为MD5时输入
parameters.name: md5_key

parameters.help_en:
The plaintext password.

The password must be 1 to 8 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

This parameter is required only if AuthenticationType is set to CLEARTEXT
parameters.help_zh:
明文认证密码。

格式要求为1~8位字符，可包含大小写字母、数字、短划线（-）或下划线（_）。

该项仅当AuthenticationType为CLEARTEXT时输入
parameters.name: password
